prefabricated-container-house.uniqueDifferentiator: A 40 ft × 12 ft (480 sqft) single home unit with bedroom, bathroom, kitchen and living zone already configured inside: a bedroom along one short end, a bathroom adjacent to it, a kitchen along one long wall, and an open living-dining area filling the rest.

specifications.section: 150×75×5 mm MS C-channel
specifications.detail: Welded MS C-channel chassis, 100×50×3 mm; final joint, support and lifting design follows completed unit weight and approved GA/BOM.

specifications.section: 80×40×3 mm MS top perimeter
specifications.detail: MS SHS/angle framing with reinforced openings, top 50×50×1.6 mm.

specifications.section: 60×40×2.5 mm rafters and 50×50×2.5 mm purlins
specifications.detail: MS SHS/angle framing with reinforced openings, roof 50×50×1.2 mm with listed secondary members.

specifications.section: 60×60×3 mm corner posts and 50×50×3 mm intermediate posts
specifications.detail: MS SHS/angle framing with reinforced openings, posts 50×50×2 mm or approved 60×60 angle.

specifications.section: Designed MS lifting hooks or lugs matched to the completed unit weight; handle only by the approved lifting and support-point drawing.
specifications.detail: Designed MS lifting hooks or lugs matched to the completed unit weight; handle only by the approved lifting and support-point drawing.

specifications.section: Welded MS fabrication with cleaned joints, safe edges, dimensional inspection and coating touch-up before panel closure and dispatch.
specifications.detail: Welded MS fabrication with cleaned joints, safe edges, dimensional inspection and coating touch-up before panel closure and dispatch.

specifications.section: 1.25–1.6 mm corrugated MS sheet
specifications.detail: Corrugated MS sheet, Tata/Jindal or approved equivalent, 1.2 mm. FRP cabin construction is excluded.

specifications.section: 1.6 mm corrugated MS sheet
specifications.detail: Sloped corrugated MS sheet with sealed laps, flashings and drainage, 1.4 mm; drainage slope, joint seal and overhang follow approved drawing.

specifications.section: 12 mm plywood with 0.8–1.0 mm laminate and selected HPL feature panels
specifications.detail: Prelaminated MDF with aluminium joint sections, 8 mm; wet areas use approved moisture-tolerant fibre-cement hygienic lining.

specifications.section: 12.5 mm gypsum or premium laminated ceiling
specifications.detail: Prelaminated MDF with aluminium joint sections, 8 mm; ceramic cladding is not part of the approved standard.

specifications.section: 19 mm marine-grade plywood or 18 mm Bison panel
specifications.detail: Bison/cement-fibre board, 18 mm.

specifications.section: 5–6 mm SPC or 3–4 mm LVT flooring
specifications.detail: Resilient finish over the board deck, 1.3 mm vinyl; wet or heavy-use floors require a documented non-ceramic safety finish and support check.

specifications.section: 75 mm mineral wool
specifications.detail: Glass wool or documented Heatlon wall option, 25 mm glass wool or 12 mm Heatlon.

specifications.section: 100 mm glass wool or mineral wool
specifications.detail: Glass wool, roof 50 mm at 42 kg/m³.

specifications.section: Standard anti-rust enamel exterior finish in an approved colour combination.
specifications.detail: The factory paint coat is the finish; no on-site painting is needed for the first 5 years.

specifications.section: Security grill, insect mesh, guard, louver or protection selected only where the approved use and opening schedule requires it.
specifications.detail: Security grill, insect mesh, guard, louver or protection selected only where the approved use and opening schedule requires it.

specifications.section: Premium insulated/laminated door with closer and upgraded lockset
specifications.detail: Outward-opening MS-framed door assembly, approximately 7×3 ft; door count, clear opening, weather seal and emergency-use requirement follow the plan.

specifications.section: Large powder-coated aluminium windows with 6 mm tinted glass
specifications.detail: Two-track aluminium sliding unit with glazing, 4 mm glass; security, privacy, service-opening and safety-glazing needs are application-specific.

specifications.section: Security grill, insect mesh, guard, louver or protection selected only where the approved use and opening schedule requires it.
specifications.detail: Security grill, insect mesh, guard, louver or protection selected only where the approved use and opening schedule requires it.

specifications.section: Concealed PVC-insulated copper wiring, typically 1.5 sq.mm lighting, 2.5 sq.mm sockets and 4 sq.mm higher-load or AC circuits, subject to the final load schedule.
specifications.detail: Concealed PVC-insulated copper wiring, typically 1.5 sq.mm lighting, 2.5 sq.mm sockets and 4 sq.mm higher-load or AC circuits, subject to the final load schedule.

specifications.section: Distribution board with MCB/RCCB protection, earthing and segregation of lighting, socket, wet-area and AC circuits according to the approved electrical drawing.
specifications.detail: Distribution board with MCB/RCCB protection, earthing and segregation of lighting, socket, wet-area and AC circuits according to the approved electrical drawing.

specifications.section: LED lights, computer/data points, UPS provision, multiple 6A/16A sockets, fan points and dedicated AC circuit.
specifications.detail: Lights, sockets, fans and AC provision; circuit quantities, breaking capacity, appliances and incoming supply follow the approved electrical drawing.

specifications.section: Container Office base services adapted only where the approved residential plan includes kitchen, basin, shower or WC connections; supply, waste, vent and external utility interfaces remain quotation-controlled.
specifications.detail: Water inlet and waste outlet brought to the bathroom corner of the unit: a 25 mm inlet pipe with shut-off valve and a 110 mm outlet to site drainage or septic. Wet-area provisions are tested at the factory and re-checked during the handover walk-through.

specifications.section: Residential configuration on the exact Container Office structural and material baseline: Residential room planning, privacy, thermal comfort, wet-service zones, storage and external utility connections adapt the portable-cabin structure for daily living. Room zoning, privacy, storage, kitchen or bathroom interfaces are fixed only on the approved house drawing.
specifications.detail: A 40 ft × 12 ft (480 sqft) single home unit with bedroom, bathroom, kitchen and living zone already configured inside: a bedroom along one short end, a bathroom adjacent to it, a kitchen along one long wall, and an open living-dining area filling the rest.

specifications.section: One red-oxide primer coat followed by two compatible anti-rust enamel coats on prepared MS surfaces; project exposure may require an upgraded coating system.
specifications.detail: Prepared MS with red-oxide primer and compatible enamel, one primer coat and two enamel coats; coastal, chemical or high-abuse exposure may require a separately approved coating system.

specifications.section: Pre-dispatch checks cover dimensions, member and sheet identification, welds, coating, roof drainage, weather sealing, doors, windows, electrical continuity and functional operation.
specifications.detail: Pre-dispatch checks cover dimensions, member and sheet identification, welds, coating, roof drainage, weather sealing, doors, windows, electrical continuity and functional operation.

specifications.section: 5-year structural warranty and 1-year finishing warranty as standard
specifications.detail: 5-year structural warranty and 1-year finishing warranty as standard
